bump.name: Bump Wheel
bump.text: +1 to the value of cargo it lands

express.name: Express Wheel
express.text: Its first spin each trip uses no fuel

padded.name: Padded Wheel
padded.text: A repeat landed here is thrown out

high_roller.name: High Roller
high_roller.text: +3 points per cargo worth 5 or more

color_guard.name: Color Guard
color_guard.text: +4 mult with 3 or more of a color

step_counter.name: Step Counter
step_counter.text: +4 mult with a run of 3 or more values

tip_jar.name: Tip Jar
tip_jar.text: +$1 for each delivery that reaches the quota

long_haul.name: Long Haul
long_haul.text: +3 mult per cargo past the third

convoy.name: Convoy
convoy.text: x2 for loads of 5 or more cargo

prism.name: Prism
prism.text: x2 with 4 or more of a color

ladder.name: Ladder
ladder.text: x2 with a run of 4 or more values

daredevil.name: Daredevil
daredevil.text: +4 mult for each cargo landed at 25% or more to spoil

the_rod.name: The Rod
the_rod.text: After a delivery, you may remove one delivered wedge from the bag

piggy_bank.name: Piggy Bank
piggy_bank.text: +30% interest on money held, up to $10

spendthrift.name: Spendthrift
spendthrift.text: +50% of money held each round; money left after the shop is lost

assembly_line.name: Assembly Line
assembly_line.text: Gains x0.2 for good each time a delivery reaches the quota

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.text: Gains +3 mult for good each time you deliver 5 or more cargo

chromatic.name: Chromatic Engine
chromatic.text: x(1 + 0.5 for each cargo past two in your biggest color group)

hazard_pay.name: Hazard Pay
hazard_pay.text: x2.5 if a tarp saved this load

double_clutch.name: Double Clutch
double_clutch.text: The first repeat in each load is thrown out

recut.name: Recut
recut.text: Change a wedge to any value from 1 to 6

paint.name: Paint
paint.text: Change a wedge to a color you choose

premium.name: Premium
premium.text: +1 to a wedge's value, up to 9

wild.name: Wild Color
wild.text: The wedge counts as any color

nudge.name: Nudge
nudge.text: When a spin would spoil the load, move the pointer one wedge

respin.name: Respin
respin.text: When a spin would spoil the load, spin that wheel again

band.name: Outer Band
band.text: For one spin, wedges that would spoil the load are half as wide

standard.name: Standard
standard.text: 12 cargo wedges and 4 plain wheels. Anything goes.

tanker.name: Tanker
tanker.text: +2 to the tank, but one fewer item slot.

reefer.name: Reefer
reefer.text: Starts with 2 tarp wedges, but quotas are 20% higher.

flatbed.name: Flatbed
flatbed.text: A truck that holds 7 values, but 2 less in the tank.

hotshot.name: Hotshot
hotshot.text: Starts with 2 crate wedges and $10, but 3 less in the tank.

monochrome.name: Monochrome
monochrome.text: Every wedge is red, but targets are 30% higher.

stamp.text: Deliver a load worth 100 or more

thermos.text: Use every spin in a tank and still deliver

express.text: Clear a round with 2 trips to spare

band.text: Save a load with a Nudge or a Respin

the_rod.text: Zap a wedge out of the bag

daredevil.text: Land cargo on a spin with 50% or more to spoil

overtime.text: Reach the quota 3 times in one round

hazard_pay.text: Have a tarp save a load of 4 or more cargo

assembly_line.text: Reach the quota 10 times in one run
